children: Evofem Biosciences entered into a Fifth Amendment to its Securities Purchase Agreement with Adjuvant to modify terms of outstanding convertible notes. The amendment sets the maturity to the earlier of December 1, 2026, a change of control at Adjuvant's election, or acceleration, and restricts prepayment before December 1, 2026 without Adjuvant's consent. It also removes certain affirmative covenants under Section 7.1. The changes are intended to extend runway and increase flexibility under the notes.
